name: kinesin family member 26B

function.text: KIF26B is the approved symbol for kinesin family member 26B. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in microtubule binding; microtubule motor activity; microtubule-based movement.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Glioblastoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: KIF26B encodes kinesin family member 26B. Based in part on similarity, it is essential for embryonic kidney development. It contributes to the compact adhesion between mesenchymal cells adjacent to the ureteric buds, possibly by interacting with MYH10. This could lead to the establishment of the basolateral integrity of the mesenchyme and the polarized expression of ITGA8, which maintains the GDNF expression required for further ureteric bud attraction.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KIF26B have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and ovarian carcinoma.
